title: Rejection on a Short Selector String
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $n$ be the number of selector symbols in its finite tabulation. For every Boolean string $y$ with $|y|<n$, the tabulated machine, started on $y$, is halted after $|y|+1$ steps and has output consisting of the single bit $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
$y$ is a list of Boolean symbols
$|y|<n$, where $n$ is the number of selector states in the tabulation
